init.darwin: env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm install --global --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com xparse-cli@2.2.1-beta.2 && env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://textin-sandbox.intsig.com
init.linux: env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm install --global --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com xparse-cli@2.2.1-beta.2 && env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://textin-sandbox.intsig.com
init.win32: set "NODE_OPTIONS=" && npm.cmd install --global --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com xparse-cli@2.2.1-beta.2 && xparse-cli.cmd --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://textin-sandbox.intsig.com

auth.darwin: env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy auth device --open-browser=always --output=jsonl
auth.linux: env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy auth device --open-browser=always --output=jsonl

unAuth.darwin: env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy auth logout --method oauth
unAuth.linux: env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy auth logout --method oauth
unAuth.win32: set "NODE_OPTIONS=" && xparse-cli.cmd --profile workbuddy auth logout --method oauth

status.darwin: env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy auth status --output=json
status.linux: env -u NODE_OPTIONS xparse-cli --profile workbuddy auth status --output=json
